When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(kableExtra)
library(gplots)
library(ggrepel)


seur = readRDS("../objects/PLAT_annotated_celltypes_cellbender_new_idents_chk_viewmastR.rds")

seur <- RenameIdents(object = seur, `14_B` = "B cells", `13_Pre.B` = "B cells", `15_Plasma` = "B cells", `21_NK` = "NK", `11_CD14.Mono` = "Monocytes", `12_CD16.Mono` = "Monocytes", `01_HSC` = "Precursor cells", `06_CLP` = "Precursor cells", `05_CMP.LMPP` = "Precursor cells", `07_GMP` = "Precursor cells", `08_GMP.Neut` = "Precursor cells", `02_Early.Eryth` = "Precursor cells", `03_Late.Eryth` = "Precursor cells", `04_Early.Baso` = "Precursor cells", `09_pDC` = "Myeloid cells", `10_cDC` = "Myeloid cells", `16_CD8.N` = "CD8", `19_CD8.EM` = "CD8", `20_CD8.CM` = "CD8", `17_CD4.N` = "CD4", `18_CD4.M` = "CD4", `leukemia` = "leukemia")

# Define the desired order of levels
custom_idents_order <- c("Precursor cells", "B cells", "Monocytes", "Myeloid cells", "NK", "CD8", "CD4", "leukemia")

# Convert 'category' to a factor with the specified levels
seur$idents_simple <- factor(Idents(seur), levels = custom_idents_order)

#seur$idents_simple <- Idents(seur)
Idents(seur) = seur$category

seur_category_simple <- subset(seur, idents = c("Mild_Tox", "Severe_Tox"))
Idents(seur_category_simple) <- seur_category_simple$idents_simple

seur_df <- cbind(cell = Cells(seur_category_simple),
		             seur_category_simple[[]],
			     Embeddings(seur_category_simple, "umap.unintegrated"), Embeddings(seur_category_simple, "umap"),
			     Embeddings(seur_category_simple, "ref.umap"), FetchData(seur_category_simple, c("GMCSF", "CXCL9", "IL6", "IL23A", "IL22", "JAK1", "JAK2", "TYK2", "STAT4", "STAT1", "STAT2", "STAT3", "STAT5", "IFNG", "IL10", "IL18", "IL2RA"), layer = "data"))

# Additional helpful columns
seur_df$individual <- sapply(strsplit(seur_df$orig.ident, "_"),`[`, 2)
seur_df$time_point <- factor(seur_df$time_point, levels = c("preA", "Day7", "Day28"))

celltypes <- levels(seur_df$seur_category_simple)
celltype_colors <- c("#F68282","#C77CFF")
names(celltype_colors) <- celltypes

Idents(seur) = seur$idents_simple
seur_df <- seur_df %>% filter(!is.na(idents_simple))

saveRDS(seur_df, file = "./objects/cell_metadata_Jan28_2026.rds")

```

```{r}
# See barplots_dge_2025-07.qmd
seur_df <- readRDS("./lindsay/data/cell_metadata_Jan28_2026.rds")
```

```{r}
#| fig.width: 7
#| fig.height: 7
#| label: fig-violin_cd79a
#| fig-cap: "Violin plot of CD79A expression by cell type and timepoint.  Only Mild_Tox and Severe_Tox are included."

pdf("./plots/Violinplot_GMCSF_chk_viewmastR_simple.pdf")
seur_df %>%
	ggplot(aes(x = idents_simple, y = GMCSF)) +
	          geom_violin(aes(idents_simple), scale = "width") +
		              geom_point(aes(colour = factor(category)), size = 0.5,
					                                     position = position_jitter()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_colors,
		                                              guide = "none") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1), geom_point() +
	  theme(
		    plot.title = element_text(size = 16),        # Plot title
		        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),      # X-axis title
		        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),      # Y-axis title
			    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),       # X-axis labels
			    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),       # Y-axis labels
			        legend.title = element_text(size = 16),      # Legend title
			        legend.text = element_text(size = 16)        # Legend text
				  )) +
    xlab("Cell type") + ylab("Expression") +
        ggtitle("GMCSF")
dev.off()
```
